name: greenhouse
description: 植物园：三座玻璃筒拱温室（里面有棕榈和花）、绿篱花园和水池

operations.code: const x0=args.x0, z0=args.z0, w=args.w, l=args.l, h=args.h; const c=(w-1)/2;box([x0,-1,z0],[x0+w-1,0,z0+l-1],'plinth'); box([x0+1,-1,z0+1],[x0+w-2,-1,z0+l-2],'grass_block');for (let z=z0; z<z0+l; z++) for (let x=x0; x<x0+w; x++) { const t=(x-x0-c)/c; const y=Math.round(h*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-t*t))); const yn=Math.round(h*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow((Math.abs(x-x0-c)+1)/c,2)))); for (let yy=Math.min(y,yn+1); yy<=y; yy++) set(x, yy+1, z, ((z-z0)%6==0) ? 'air' : ((x-x0)%5==0 ? 'rib' : 'glass')); }for (let k=0;k<6;k++) tree({at:[x0+4+randInt(0,w-9),0,z0+6+k*Math.floor((l-12)/6)], kind: pick(['palm','jungle','cherry','oak']), seed:k+x0});scatter({from:[x0+1,-1,z0+1],to:[x0+w-2,1,z0+l-2], block:'flowers', density:0.12, on:['grass_block']});for (let z=z0+5; z<z0+l-3; z+=10) set(x0+Math.round(c), h-1, z, 'lantern[hanging=true]');
